column3: Close to the Hebrew; “also the world is established” is rendered “Surely the world is established, so that it cannot be moved.”
Close to the Hebrew; “from then” is rendered “of old.”
Close to the Hebrew; נְהָרוֹת (“rivers”) is rendered “The floods,” and דָּכְיָם (“their pounding”) “their waves.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV reorders the verse, “The LORD on high is mightier,” and “the breakers of the sea” is rendered “the mighty waves.”
Close to the Hebrew; “holiness is befitting your house” is rendered “Holiness adorns Your house,” and “for length of days” “forever.”
